title: Audit Committee - September 12, 2025
meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on September 24, 2025, in Audit Committee Report 13.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Thursday, September 11, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Friday, September 12.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Nathalie Gougeon, Auditor General, answered questions from the Committee.
Ms. Gougeon undertook to provide additional information on audit follow-up procedures comparisons with other municipalities.
There were no public submissions on this item.
Following discussions, the Committee considered the report recommendation(s) as follows:

motions.motion_text:
Report recommendation(s)
That the Audit Committee recommend Council receive the Semi-Annual Report on Follow-up Procedures.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Nathalie Gougeon, Auditor General, Joanne Gorenstein, Deputy Auditor General, and Cory Richardson, Audit Manager, presented an overview of the report and answered questions from the Committee.  A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
Stuart Huxley, City Solicitor, Marcia Wallace, General Manager, Planning, Development and Building Services, and Derrick Moodie, Director, Planning Services, also answered questions from Committee.
There were no public submissions on this item.
Following discussions, the Committee considered the report recommendation(s) as follows:

motions.motion_text:

That the Audit Committee receive the audit report andrecommend that Council consider and approve the recommendations.

agenda_items.title: In Camera Items
agenda_items.description: That, in accordance with the Procedure By-law (By-law No. 2025-100), the Audit Committee resolve In Camera pursuant to Subsection 13(1)(a), the security of the property of the city, based upon the rationale set out in the respective Legal Implications section of the reports “Office of the Auditor General (OAG) – Follow-Up Report: Audit of Cybersecurity” (File No. ACS2025-OAG-BVG-012) and “Office of the Auditor General (OAG) – Follow-Up Report: Cybersecurity Investigation” (File No. ACS2025-OAG-BVG-013). These reports will not be reported out.

motions.motion_text: BE IT RESOLVED THAT, in accordance with the Procedure By-law (By-law No. 2025-100), the Audit Committee resolve In Camera pursuant to Subsection 13(1)(a), the security of the property of the city, based upon the rationale set out in the re-spective Legal Implications section of the reports “Office of the Auditor General (OAG) – Follow-Up Report: Audit of Cybersecurity” (File No. ACS2025-OAG-BVG-012) and “Office of the Auditor General (OAG) – Follow-Up Report: Cybersecurity Investigation” (File No. ACS2025-OAG-BVG-013). These reports will not be report-ed out.
motions.post_motion_text: Committee resolved in camera at 11:15 am, and resumed in open session at 12:45 pm.Upon resuming in open session, Chair C. Curry advised that the Audit Committee met in camera to consider items 5.1 and 5.2 (listed below).These matters will not be reported out as they relate to Subsection 13(1)(a) of the Procedure By-law, as the subject matter relates to the security of the property of the City.During the in camera session, no votes were taken other than procedural motions and/or directions to staff.Committee carried the following report recommendations in open meeting.
